HDFC Large Cap Fund Direct Growth

Expense Ratio

The expense ratio for Direct Growth plan is 0.96% as on 31 May 2026.

Exit Load

Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year. Nil after 1 year.

Minimum Investment

Minimum SIP
Rs 100
Minimum Lumpsum
Rs 5000

Riskometer

Very High risk as per SEBI riskometer classification.

Benchmark

NIFTY 100 Total Return Index.

Lock-in Period

Not applicable for this open-ended scheme.

Investment Objective

The investment objective of the scheme is to provide long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in large-cap companies. The fund aims to generate consistent returns over market cycles while maintaining a diversified portfolio of established Indian companies with strong fundamentals and sustainable growth.
